functions.tax_rate_pct(region): region: str|None -> Decimal percent from data_tax/rates.csv. None (unknown customer) -> Decimal(0). Unrecognized non-None region -> KeyError.
functions.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=: lines: iterable of (amount_cents:int, category:str) for every invoice line. region: str|None (customer region). discount_pct: number (customer discount percent, default 0). Returns int cents. Exempt categories (data_tax/exempt_categories.csv) are excluded from the taxable amount. base = taxable*(100-discount_pct)/100; tax = base*rate/100, rounded half-up to cents once, at the end (Decimal, no float).

why: Explicit lines+region+discount inputs keep tax.py free of customer/item lookups; pricing.py supplies lines, region and discount; invoice.py calls compute_tax and does no tax rules.
invoice.py will call tax.compute_tax(lines=[(amount_cents, category)] for every known line, region, discount_pct) and tax_rate_pct(region); I do no tax rules
tax.py implemented to this API; boundary conversion for pricing data is agent1/agent3's responsibility.
